statusDetail: Navigation was attempted with Chrome CDP, a direct curl request, raw-fetch discoverability, DOM capture, and an evaluate probe. The origin refused TCP connections: Chrome returned chrome-error://chromewebdata/ with ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED, curl could not connect to port 443, and raw fetch failed. The site content and representative routes were therefore unavailable for inspection.

page.notes: The only rendered DOM was Chrome’s network error page. It must not be mistaken for site-authored content.

artifacts.caption: Desktop navigation attempt showing Chrome ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED.
DOM capture of the browser-generated connection error page, not site-authored content.
Evaluate probe confirms chrome-error://chromewebdata/ and ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED.
Raw crawler fetch failed; rendered capture is Chrome connection-error UI.
Browser-view capture of the connection error.
Crawler-view capture after the raw origin fetch failed.
Header primitive output from a failed navigation. Missing-header signals are not treated as site evidence because no origin response was received.
Cookie primitive output from a failed navigation; no site response was received.
Tracker primitive output from the browser error state; not treated as site evidence.
Secrets primitive output from the browser error state; site assets were unavailable.
